patches.name: AMOLED theme
patches.description: Uses pure black for dark-mode Compose and View surfaces when enabled.

patches.name: Disable swipe to camera
patches.description: Stops a swipe right on the home feed from opening the camera. The camera button and deep links still open it.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Adds a download button beside the save icon on feed posts and reels and beside the reply pill on stories. Posts with several media open a bottom sheet to pick what to save.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Lets you watch stories, Instants and messages without being marked as seen. Each surface has its own toggle in Piko settings.

patches.name: Hide feed ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts and ad units from the main feed.

patches.name: Hide reels and stories ads
patches.description: Stops Instagram from inserting ads into Reels and Stories. The same ad injector also feeds Explore and the contextual feeds, so they stay ad-free too.
